spans.s: लाबः [lābḥ] लाबकः [lābakḥ], लाबकः A sort of quail.
Obtained, (as by division &c.); see लभ्. -ब्धा A woman whose husband or lover is faithless (perhaps for विप्रलब्धा).
ब्धम् That which is secured or got; लब्धं रक्षेदवक्षयात्
A profit, gain; लब्धाच्च सप्तमं भागं तथा शृङ्गे कला खुरे
Comp. अनुज्ञ one who has obtained leave of absence.
one who is free from ब्रह्मचारी duties of उपनयन; Gīrvāṇa -अन्तर a.
one who has got access or admission; लब्धा- न्तरा सावरणे$पि गेहे
(anything) that has gained a scope (for work); लब्धावकाशा मे प्रार्थना Ś.1.
one who has obtained leisure, being at leisure; so लब्धलक्षण. -आस्पद a. one who has gained a footing or secured a position; लब्धास्पदो$स्मीति विवादभीरोः
born, produced, sprung; लब्धोदया चान्द्रमसीव लेखा
one who has got prosperity or elevation; स त्वत्तो लब्धोदयः 'he owes his rise or elevation to you'. -काम a. one who has got his desired object; याच्ञा मोघा वरमधिगुणे नाधमे लब्धकामा

. -कीर्ति a. become widely known, famous, celebrated. -चेतस्, -संज्ञ a. one who has come to his senses, restored to consciousness. -जन्मन् a. born, produced. -तीर्थ a. one who has gained an opportunity. -धन a. wealthy.-नामन्, -शब्द a. renowned, celebrated. -नाशः the loss of what has been acquired; लब्धनाशो यथा मृत्युः. -प्रतिष्ठa. one who has acquired fame. -प्रत्यय a. one who has won confidence.
प्रशमनम् securing or keeping safe what has been acquired.
bestowing on a worthy recipient; Kull. on
. -प्रसर a. moving at liberty, unimpeded; श्रीर्लब्धप्रसरेव वेशवनिता दुःखोपचर्या भृशम्
.-प्रसाद a. favourite; अन्येभ्यश्च वसन्ति ये$स्य भवने लब्धप्रसादा विटाः
one who has hit the mark.
skilled in the use of missiles; अन्ये च बहवः शूरा लब्धलक्षा निशाचराः
. -लक्षण a. one who has gained an opportunity. -वर्ण a.
learned, wise; चित्रं त्वदीये विषये समन्तात् सर्वे$पि लोकाः किल लब्धवर्णाः Rāj. P; यत्राहुः स्थितममृतं च लब्धवर्णाः Rām.
. ˚भाज् a. respecting the learned; कृत्छ्रलब्धमपि लब्धवर्णभाक् तं दिदेश मुनये सलक्ष्मणम्
. -विद्य a. learned, educated, wise. -श्रुत्, -श्रुत a. well-versed, learned (बहुश्रुत); लब्धश्रुतां धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः
. -संज्ञ a. restored to consciousness.-सिद्धि a. one who has attained perfection or his desired object.
Acquisition, gaining, acquirement; समाश्रयेत् सद्गुरुमात्मलब्धये A.
लाबुः [lābuḥ] बूः [būḥ] , (बूः) A kind of gourd.
लाबुकायनः [lābukāyanḥ], N. of an old authority on philosophy quoted by Jaimini;
